HReview.actual_original_Haar_kernel_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (nu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (alpha s V : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V) (U R F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  have b := fun y => Masullo.GenuineMellinJet.nativeHalfWeight alpha s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y);
  ↑(b x) *
      ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑U) (↑↑R) x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
    inner ℂ R F * ↑↑U x
